title: The Iron Republic
description: The Iron Republic is a long-term Create-based civilization sandbox where infrastructure, transportation, industry, and exploration shape the growth of a living world.
body:
The Iron Republic

The Iron Republic is a Create-focused industrial civilization modpack built around transportation, infrastructure, logistics, engineering, and the growth of a living world.

Rather than rushing through progression, players are encouraged to build a connected nation through railways, airships, shipping routes, factories, and expanding settlements. Every town can serve a purpose, every railway can support industry, and every new project contributes to the growth of the Republic.

 Core Features

 Industrial Engineering

Create provides mechanical automation, power generation, factories, and engineering systems.
Create Addition expands Create's industrial capabilities with additional technology and machinery.
Create Big Cannons adds large-scale artillery, naval guns, and military engineering projects.

 Transportation Networks

Create: Steam 'n' Rails introduces trains, monorails, stations, rail yards, and long-distance transportation.
Create Aeronautics allows players to design and pilot functional airships for exploration, cargo transport, and military applications.
 Additional naval content supports ports, harbors, and maritime infrastructure.

 Building & Architecture

Chipped, Supplementaries, FramedBlocks, and Create Copycats+ provide thousands of decorative options for factories, stations, ports, warehouses, cities, and industrial districts.
 Additional furniture and decoration mods help settlements feel lived in and believable.

 Logistics & Storage

Storage Drawers provides large-scale bulk storage for industrial production.
Tom's Simple Storage connects warehouses and storage facilities into practical logistics networks without sacrificing immersion.

 Farming & Settlement Life

Farmer's Delight expands farming and cooking, helping towns and settlements feel functional and alive.
 Wildlife and atmosphere mods add environmental detail to forests, coastlines, rivers, and remote regions.

 Exploration & World Generation

Terralith, Tectonic, and other world generation improvements create vast landscapes filled with mountains, rivers, coastlines, valleys, and opportunities for expansion.
 Enhanced structures and dungeons encourage exploration beyond the frontier.

 Performance & Quality of Life

 Carefully selected optimization mods improve stability and performance while maintaining compatibility with large Create contraptions and transportation networks.
 Recipe viewers, inventory improvements, and utility mods streamline gameplay without changing the core experience.

 The Goal

The Iron Republic is not about completing a questbook or reaching a final machine.

It is about creating a world that feels alive.

Build a capital city connected by monorails and railways. Establish mining settlements in the mountains. Develop farming communities across the countryside. Expand harbors, airship ports, factories, and industrial districts as your civilization grows.

Whether you're constructing a massive rail network, operating a naval fleet, managing logistics, or simply building a thriving town, every project contributes to the story of the Republic.

Forge the rails. Build the cities. Expand the frontier.

Welcome to The Iron Republic.
